title: Stop Saying "It's Ruined": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for ruined? When you build the house yourself and it ends up like this, it's not just ruined. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Falling apart: breaking into pieces
• In ruins: badly damaged, destroyed
• Uninhabitable: not safe or fit to live in (formal)

Would you still live there?

Clip: One Week (1920)
